# Handover 1.1

**What landed**
- `7e332f1` — baseline validation/hardening only; no game features or production
  behavior changes.
- Added six high-count word probes at 1/99/9999 with recorded final positions,
  pending count/find/go blur regressions, and blocked modified Escape/Enter/
  Backspace plus Other browser regressions.
- Added the retained baseline probe `tools/experiments/first-playable-timing.ts`
  and `just timing`; it drives the production bundle through sequential synthetic
  keydowns (no Playwright round trips), 3 warmups and 5 measured runs.
- `artifacts/` is ignored. This run's machine-readable result is
  `artifacts/first-playable-timing-baseline.json`; raw logs remain outside Git.

**Baseline receipt**
- Active original IDs/cases: all 50 navigation obligations; first-playable
  requirement IDs/cases remain pending (none owned by 1.1).
- Checks green: `direnv exec . just verify`, `direnv exec . just test` and
  `nix develop --command just verify`: 53 fixture examples, 50 named navigation
  checks, 92 core tests, 24 browser tests (12 development + 12 production),
  typecheck and benchpress lint. `just contract-complete` separately green.
- Repairs: none required. The existing fixed-point word optimization remains.
- Timing, 49 commands on the 40x20 seed, Linux x86_64, Bun 1.3.13, Chromium
  150.0.7871.181: max single dispatch 2.00 ms (`e`, count 9999); most medians
  0.20–0.50 ms. Word high-count finals from start 0: `w`/`W` 6, 799, 799;
  `b`/`B` 0, 0, 0; `e`/`E` 4, 799, 799. No timing threshold is claimed.
- Harness/model/provider: OpenCode / `deepseek/deepseek-flash`, high effort.
  Token/cost/elapsed figures are not available to this session and are not
  invented here.

**Landmark drift**
- None in the named source/tests/justfile. The plan targets `15f3e2c`; the
  working tree already contained the later planning commit `092d919`, but no
  production navigation code differs from the plan's assumptions.
- The old timing script was never in Git; the retained probe is new, not a
  recovered file.

**Deviations from the work order**
- `just timing`, `artifacts/` in `.gitignore` and one README line were added so
  the timing probe is usable and its output cannot be committed accidentally.
- The probe currently measures the existing seed in the production browser. It
  does not yet measure the 240x160 site world or all-space text because this
  stage has no selection/factory path into the browser; final assembly owns
  those extensions.

**What the next session must know**
- Navigation production code is untouched: `words.wordMove`, `model.field/pack/
  view`, `actualApi` and browser blur/input handlers are as landed before this
  unit. `just verify` now includes `first-playable-fixtures`, `contract` and
  `contract-complete`.
- Browser blur coverage is now count, FindRight, FindLeft and Go. Blocked
  Escape/Backspace/Enter and Other preserve a pending find.
- `just timing` builds first, writes to `artifacts/` by default, and accepts an
  optional output path argument. It records environment plus per-command
  samples, final position/mode, median and max.
- No `spec/first-playable/coverage.json` exists yet. Unit 2.1 creates it and
  activates W1/W2 while marking later work pending; baseline work must not be
  presented as a first-playable requirement.
- Benchpress lint still warns about the historical missing
  `vim-game-bend-main.md` link in `docs/workbench/first-playable-rts.md`; the
  command exits green. No flake file changed, so `check-nix` was not rerun.

**Open problems**
- Extend the timing probe to all-space text via the real core factory and to
  the 240x160 world with sites in the browser-facing units; add the bounded
  direct-core stress probe required by shared §9 then.
- Measurements are one host, one headless Chromium and one production bundle;
  they are finite evidence, not a universal latency or usability claim.

# Handover 2.1

**What landed**
- `ef2c925` — new pure `src/core/world.ts` plus cumulative `src/core/game.ts`

  composed semantic glyphs and five reserved ring slots.
- `tests/core/first-playable-world.test.ts` runs all four `world.json` cases
  through the real factory/observations and adds independent W1/W2 roundtrip,
  normalization, boundary, non-overlap, glyph and purity checks.
- `spec/first-playable/coverage.json` activates W1/W2 with all world cases and
  marks N1 through T2 pending by owning unit.
- Workbench topic now carries a one-line progress pointer; no new narrative.

**Baseline vs new feature**
- Baseline receipt remains unit 1.1 / `7e332f1`: 50 navigation obligations,
  92 core and 24 browser tests. This unit adds 15 world tests (107 core total)
  and changes no navigation, browser or timing behavior.

**Active state**
- Active requirements: W1, W2. Active cases: `world.initial`,
  `world.far-target`, `world.outside-site`, `world.boundary-site`.
- Later groups remain unregistered; no skip/todo/only filtering was introduced.

**Checks**
- `direnv exec . just verify`: green (fixture integrity 53/18, 50 named navigation
  checks, typecheck, 107 core tests, 24 browser tests development+production,
  benchpress lint warning only for the historical missing note link).
- `direnv exec . just test`: green, 107 pass.
- `direnv exec . just first-playable-fixtures`: green; it still states that it
  does not assess implementation.
- Harness/model/provider: OpenCode / `deepseek/deepseek-flash`, high effort.
  No usage/cost/elapsed figures were exposed to this session; none invented.
  No timing probe is claimed for this unit.

**Landmark drift**
- Named landmarks (`src/core/model.ts`, `spec/navigation/api.ts`,
  `src/core/navigation.ts`, `tests/core/navigation-model.test.ts`) are unchanged.
  The existing 40x20 model remains the compatibility contract; the game world is
  a separate facade. No source drift required a repair.

**Deviations from the work order**
- Used a new private `world.ts` behind `game.ts` rather than generalizing the old
  model in place, keeping old exports/tests untouched.
- Scenario input accepts only the core corpus fields currently needed
  (`navigationOnly`, `rows`, `cursor`, `buildings`, `pendingSource`) and rejects
  unknown fields; it does not yet accept later mode/clock fixtures.
- `snapshot` is the observable roundtrip constructor; it omits all-blank
  navigation rows because they reconstruct identically.

**What the next session must know**
- `game.field(world)` returns `{width: 240, height: 160, text}` in world space;
  `glyphAt`/`siteAt` are pure queries. `game.field(...).text` is the intended
  generalized 240x160 input for navigation in 2.2.
- `navigationOnly` scenarios have zero sites/buildings and cursor-targeting null;
  rows are sanitized code point by code point, truncated/padded to 240.
- Rings derive exactly slots 1..produced; rally coordinates are site origin
  plus relative columns 1,3,5,7,9 on relative row 6.
- Invalid scenarios throw rather than falling back to defaults. Well links and
  pending sources require an existing well/ring of the right kind.
- Simulation observations currently report constant Normal, count 0, no menu,
  unpaused, visible, zero clock/remainder; those become real in later units.

**Open problems**
- README/direction still describe the game as planned; stage 7 owns updating the
  public description to what actually runs.
- No browser/camera/navigation wiring uses the new world yet; that starts in 2.2
  and 3.1.
- The world test file contains the minimal corpus adapter; later units may extend
  it with event dispatch and additional group registration.

DONE

# Handover 2.2

**What landed**
- `c588f71` — generalized pure navigation engine in `src/core/game-navigation.ts`
  (240x160 layout factory, axis/word/WORD/line/find, grammar parser).
- `src/core/world.ts` now stores the navigation mode/count, reads the current
  composed field for every motion, and exposes `game.dispatch` for key/blur.
- `tests/core/first-playable-navigation.test.ts` runs all 10 navigation.json
  cases plus independent bounds, row-split, punctuation, blank/malformed field,
  pending-mode, cancellation, composed-glyph, preservation and fixed-point tests.
- Coverage activates N1/N2 (9 and 3 cases) with all later IDs still pending.

**Baseline vs new feature**
- Baseline receipt remains unit 1.1 / `7e332f1`: 50 navigation obligations,
  92 core and 24 browser tests.
- This unit adds 24 core tests (131 total). Old 40x20 modules, exports, contract
  hashes and 50 named checks are untouched. Browser still uses the old facade.

**Checks**
- `direnv exec . just verify`: green (fixtures 53/18, 50 named navigation checks,
  typecheck, 131 core tests, 24 browser tests development+production, benchpress
  lint warning only for the historical missing note link).
- `direnv exec . just test`: green, 131 pass.
- Harness/model/provider: OpenCode / `deepseek/deepseek-flash`, high effort.
  No usage/cost/elapsed figures were exposed; none invented. No timing probe was
  run or claimed for this unit.

**Landmark drift**
- All named landmarks (`axis.ts`, `words.ts`, `lines.ts`, `find.ts`, `input.ts`,
  `spec/navigation/helpers.ts`, the game facade) are present and unchanged.
- The new generalized engine is a separate private module; it reuses only the
  dimension-free spec predicates (`printable`, `classify`, `effective`,
  `appendCount`, `character`).

**Deviations from the work order**
- Generalized navigation was added beside the old modules rather than refactoring
  them in place, so the 40x20 compatibility contract stays byte-identical.
- `GameEvent` currently supports only `{type:"key"}` and `{type:"blur"}`; later
  units must extend the union and the dispatch switch.
- Normal Escape already clears `pendingSource` per shared §5, although full
  insert/leader cancellation waits for units 4.1/5.1.

**What the next session must know**
- Drive navigation with `game.dispatch(state, {type:"key", key, blocked?})` and
  `game.dispatch(state, {type:"blur"})`. `observe` now reports the real mode and
  count; `game.field(world).text` is the composed 240x160 glyph input.
- Pending modes are reached through keys (`f`, `F`, `g`, digits); scenario
  setup still starts Normal/count 0. Literal `i`, `p` and Space work as find
  targets (tested), but have no Normal-mode game binding yet.
- `snapshot` still encodes world configuration only; it does not carry the
  transient navigation mode/count. Old W1 roundtrip fixtures are unaffected.
- I1 remains pending even though `nav.find-space`/`nav.find-literal-*` are listed
  under N1; later I1 work must claim those cases without removing them from N1.
- Stage 3 must connect the browser to `game.dispatch`; today `src/web/main.ts`
  still drives the old 40x20 `actualApi`.

**Open problems**
- If W1's observable roundtrip is meant to include dispatched navigation states,
  `snapshot`/`scenario` need compatible mode/count fields (and later menu, draft,
  pause, clock fields). This unit deliberately did not invent that schema.
- Normal `Space`/`i`/`p` currently behave as unsupported printable input (they
  clear a count); the Leader, insert and pause bindings are later units.
- No camera, viewport or world navigation wiring exists in the browser yet.
- No new timing measurement was made; only finite runtime/property evidence.

# Handover 3.1

**What landed**
- `ca94c2a` — full-window 240x160 viewport, 32px HUD, 12x20 CSS cells, DPR backing and the integer camera helper in `src/web/camera.ts`.
- `src/web/main.ts` now drives `game` (not the old `actualApi`) through key/blur dispatch, including focus, blocked modifiers, composition and blur.
- Browser navigation was rewritten for the 240x160 world; new camera/resize/DPR tests cover V1. `coverage.json` activates V1 and keeps V2 onward pending.

**Baseline vs new feature**
- Baseline receipt remains unit 1.1 / `7e332f1`: 50 navigation obligations, original 40x20 core exports/contracts unchanged.
- This unit adds 9 core camera tests (140 total) and 20 browser tests per project (44 total across development+production).
- Timing script was retargeted from the old 40-column row to row 240 and smoke-run: 49 commands, 3 warmups, 5 runs, ~0.2–2.8 ms medians. Artifact is ignored/local; no usage/cost figures were exposed and none invented.
- Harness/model/provider: OpenCode / `deepseek/deepseek-flash`, high effort.

**Checks**
- `direnv exec . just verify`: green (fixtures 53/18, 50 named navigation checks, typecheck, 140 core tests, 44 browser tests in development+production, benchpress warning only for the historical missing note link).
- `direnv exec . just test`: green, 140 pass.

**Landmark drift**
- All named landmarks exist. The old 40x20 browser fixture was replaced as the plan permits; direct core regressions and all 50 named checks remain.
- `tests/browser/navigation.spec.ts` is rewritten, not deleted; `tests/browser/viewport.spec.ts` is new.
- Camera logic is presentation code in `src/web/camera.ts`; its corpus tests live in `tests/core/first-playable-camera.test.ts` so `just test` exercises them.

**Deviations from the work order**
- Link lines/arrowheads and incident-link highlighting are deferred to V2: there is still no construction/link command path, and the initial world has no links. The renderer draws the core field glyphs, sites, imps and cursor only.
- Hidden visibility dispatches the same cancellation as blur but does not suspend time; the core has no visibility/suspension event yet (T2/V2).
- HUD shows observed values only: site kind/mana/link/produced, mode/count, source, draft, pause/suspended flags and elapsed ticks (currently always zero until the clock unit).

**What the next session must know**
- Use `game.dispatch(state, {type:"key", key, blocked?})` and `{type:"blur"}`; the event union still lacks construction/link/elapsed/visibility.
- Canvas `data-*` exposes cursor, camera, visible columns/rows, cell size, DPR, mode/count, pending source, draft, pause/suspension, elapsed ticks/remainder and `data-position = y*240+x` for the timing script.
- Camera state is carried between renders and re-followed on movement/resize; `followCamera` is pure and clamps to `max(0, world-visible)`.
- The HUD is a 32px bottom bar; `index.html`/`style.css` use a fixed full-viewport flex column with `overflow:hidden`.
- `just timing` now expects the new 240-column row; do not restore the old 40-column reset.

**Open problems**
- V2 must add link/arrow rendering, selected-link highlight, staged-source preview, and visibility-driven time suspension.
- The browser cannot yet construct, link, type, pause or advance time; those remain later units.
- `snapshot` still does not carry camera or transient states; camera is intentionally outside the core.
- No usage/cost/elapsed session metrics were available. Only the timing smoke-run above was observed.

# Handover 4.1

**What landed**
- `4bb9254` — Leader/Build modes, targeted-site capture, `w`/`r` selection, Enter construction, Escape cancellation, pure `game.build` and side-effect-free `game.preview`.
- Core observation adds `buildTarget` and `notice`; the browser HUD shows contextual build status and the canvas draws preview glyphs from the core composition.
- Activated B1/B2/I1, construction.json and browser construction coverage. Updated README, workbench pointer and cumulative coverage assertions.
- Baseline receipt remains unit 1.1 / `7e332f1`: 50 navigation obligations and the original 40x20 contracts are unchanged. This unit adds 19 core tests (159 total) and 4 browser tests per project (52 total). Harness/model/provider: OpenCode / `deepseek/deepseek-flash`, high effort. No usage/cost metrics were available; none invented.

**Checks**
- `direnv exec . just verify`: green (fixtures 53/18, 50 named navigation checks, typecheck, 159 core tests, 52 browser tests across development+production, benchpress historical-link warning only).
- `direnv exec . just test`: green, 159 pass.

**Landmark drift**
- All named landmarks exist. The construction browser suite is new at `tests/browser/construction.spec.ts`; it reuses the existing fixture and viewport assumptions.
- The new public preview/build exports are `game.preview` and `game.build`; mode-specific construction state stays private in `src/core/world.ts`.

**Deviations from the work order**
- Added `buildTarget` and `notice` to the observation surface so preview/error context is observable without reading private state; the corpus ignores these extra fields.
- Preview is a hypothetical core composition: it returns the real field unchanged when the target is occupied or the world is navigation-only.
- Direct `build` events apply only the pure build transition and leave mode/menu alone; keyboard Enter wraps the same transition and always returns Normal.

- `GameMode` is now `Mode | Leader | Build`; only the four navigation modes may enter `navigation.step`.
- Build preserves `pendingSource` on open/select/confirm/cancel. Normal Escape clears it; blur clears everything.
- Occupied confirmation returns Normal with a notice and no mutation; blocked keys are strict identity even in Build.
- Punctuation preview glyphs can lack full-color pixels, so browser pixel checks sample the thick `WELL`/`RING` label row instead.
- Browser datasets now expose `buildingCount`, `menuSelection`, `buildTarget` and `notice` alongside the existing camera/cursor fields.

**Open problems**
- The later units still own typed `connect`, links/arrows, economy ticks, imps, elapsed time and visibility suspension.
- `notice` is transient UI text and is not part of snapshot/scenario roundtrips; menu state is also not snapshotted.
- Preview intentionally shows nothing for occupied sites until Enter reports the error; there is no separate invalid-preview warning.

# Handover 5.1

**What landed**
- `35320d9` — bounded Insert drafts, exact `connect`, well staging by Escape/Enter, ring commit, retry and Normal/blur cancellation. One pure `game.link` transition backs direct events and keyboard commits.
- Observation now derives `links` (source/target/endpoint cells), `insertSite`, `pendingFrom` and the live `commandBuffer`; the field text remains untouched by typing and links.
- Browser draws clipped directed arrows behind glyphs, highlights incident links, outlines the staged source and draws a dashed preview line to the cursor; HUD names the source and Insert draft.
- Activated I2/L1/L2 with all 10 connections.json cases plus independent Insert, linking, reroute, crossing, clipping and browser checks. Coverage documents later E1–E4/T1/T2/V2 as pending.

**Checks**
- `direnv exec . just verify`: green (fixtures 53/18, 50 named navigation checks, typecheck, 180 core tests, 58 browser tests across development+production, benchpress historical-link warning only).
- `direnv exec . just test`: green, 180 pass.
- Harness/model/provider: OpenCode / `deepseek/deepseek-flash`, high effort. No usage/cost metrics were available; none invented.

**Landmark drift**
- No named landmark moved. New files are `src/web/overlay.ts` (pure segment clipping/arrow/cell geometry), `tests/core/first-playable-connections.test.ts` and `tests/browser/connections.spec.ts`.
- `game.link` and `GameEvent { type: "link" }` are the new exported link action/event; `game.build`/`game.preview` are unchanged.

**Deviations from the work order**
- Added derived `links`, `insertSite` and `pendingFrom` observation fields so rendering never reads private state or recreates site coordinates. Corpus partial matching ignores them.
- Extracted link clipping and arrowhead geometry into `src/web/overlay.ts`; this makes off-screen clipping and crossing independence directly testable without browser-only seed hooks.
- Insert mode stores its captured site separately from Build's `buildTarget`; Build behavior is unchanged.
- Crossing/off-screen link behavior is checked by core topology plus pure overlay geometry, with an additional browser off-screen-clipping check; there is no browser scenario-injection hook.

**What the next session must know**
- `GameMode` is now `Mode | Leader | Build | Insert`; Insert must be dispatched before the global Escape/navigation paths.
- Insert Escape stages only an exact `connect` at a well; ring Escape always preserves the source and abandons the draft. Ring Enter with no source is an error with no mutation.
- `link` returns the same world object for invalid endpoints and for repeating the same link. Keyboard success clears `pendingSource`; direct `game.link` preserves mode/source.
- Link endpoints are live-derived from `SITE_DEFINITIONS` centers, not stored in snapshot/scenario; W1 roundtrips still compare equal because links are derived from buildings.
- Browser palette additions: link `#5d8c9e`, selected link `#8fd3c0`, source `#d9a05b`; datasets include `links`, `linkCount`, `insertSite`, `sourceHighlight` and `commandBuffer`.

**Open problems**
- Economy ticks, mana transfer, imps, elapsed/remainder, pause and visibility suspension remain for 6.1/7.1.
- Insert mode, draft, menu selection and notice are not part of snapshot/scenario; only Normal fixtures roundtrip today.
- The browser test verifies an off-screen link disappears rather than a segment crossing a partially visible viewport; clipping across viewport edges is covered by overlay geometry tests.
